label: q/o/f/d/0/a or <DEL> input at steps 2-5 of sequences starting with t/k/y/s/j
explanation: Conjunctive unit. It fires when the input is one of q, o, f, d, 0, a or <DEL>, early in the sequence (steps 2-5; never on steps 0-1, rare in the copy phase except the step right after <DEL>), and an earlier token in the prefix is from {t,k,y,s,j,2,3,r,p}, mostly the first token. first_tok==t is by far the strongest context (7.7x lift; precision 0.65 with the token and position conditions, and t t prefixes give the top activations). Magnitude goes up with t in the first token(s) and with shorter, earlier contexts. Repeated input tokens rarely fire it. Mostly silent on other letters (l, c, i, v, 1) and in late copy steps. The context dependence is spread across many prefix tokens, so a simple predicate is imprecise. Dev F1 is about 0.38 and mass recall about 0.58.
